address: 48 Hang Vai Street, Hang Bo Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, 100000, Vietnam
bio: Early risers delight in this beef phở haven, open from 5:30am until mid‐morning, when beef cuts and broth are sold out. Fresh ingredients shine in the signature beef heel muscle, which boasts tender meat and gelatinous tendon with a pleasant chew. Order phở with eggs and fried dough, just like the locals....
